description:
We are Team THARA (Amman 2026), tackling climate and agricultural challenges in Jordan by using NASA Earth observation data to build smart, data-driven irrigation & farming tools. Based in Amman, we blend tech with natural impact.

We’re looking for passionate minds in:

• AI / ML & Data Analysis

• Software / Web Dev & UI/UX

• Earth Science / Agriculture

Join THARA to build solutions that touch the earth and empower local farmers! Let's innovate together.
